new_value: Fixed NaN/inf silent position corruption across all four mobility patterns in python/src/lichen/sim/mobility.py. New helpers: _require_finite (math.isfinite reject of NaN/+-inf; >0 enforcement with allow_zero for bound components — the bead's core finding was that 'nan <= 0 is False' defeated every existing check) and _require_finite_bounds (finite components + min<max). Wired into all four __post_init__: RandomWaypoint GAINED validation matching its siblings (was entirely unvalidated — speed finite>0, pause>=0, bounds finite+ordered); GroupMobility/RPGM/ManhattanGrid speed/bounds/spacing now pass through the finite guard while every original range check (group_size, radius, jitter, max_offset, pause_probability, radius+jitter proportionality) is preserved (two proportionality sites re-unpacked as _min_x/max_x to avoid shadowing). Both bead attack vectors closed: NaN speed/bounds can no longer construct and write NaN into set_position (regression-pinned by test), and inf speed (distance/inf*1e6==0 arrival charging that burned the 100k iteration cap) is now rejected. Reviewer-verified: the only non-test constructor caller is scenario.py fed from config literals (no computed-inf path), NaN pause remains harmless-by-structure (guards behind _pause_remaining_us > 0; noted as optional follow-up, not a dropped check). Legacy test_pauses_at_waypoint used degenerate bounds (10,10,10,10) now invalid — rewritten to a valid 1x1 area asserting pause+in-bounds (seeded waypoints vary; reviewer verified deterministic: leg completes within one step at 100 m/s from (0,0)). Tests: 8 new NaN/inf/bounds/degenerate rejections incl. the NaN-geometry pin. Full sim suite 1661 passed; ruff clean. 3x review (kimi-k3): correctness PASS (helpers correct, all original checks preserved, equivalence of re-unpack verified), security+edge PASS (config-fed values fail closed, inf amplification closed, NaN pause structural harmlessness documented), edge PASS (unpack positions correct, pause test deterministic, match strings align with raised messages).
